{{Quote|Who is ''that''?!''"<br />"''My ex-wife. Tes Vevec. Don't shoot her.|[[Anj Dahl]] and [[Hondo Karr]]|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
'''Tes Vevec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. When [[Vevec|her father]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Botajef]], Vevec was told by the newly-proclaimed [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Yaga Auchs]], that her ex-[[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Hondo Karr]] had become a traitor to the Mandalorians and was the one responsible for murdering her [[Parent/Legends|father]]. Determined to avenge her father, Vevec tracked Karr, who had joined up with the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] on [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]], only to defect to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] at later point in [[Time/Legends|time]]. She eventually located Karr on [[Da Soocha]]'s [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Napdu]], and confronted him with the intent to kill. Karr managed to survive Vevec's assault long enough to subdue his ex-wife and force her to hear the truth: Yaga Auchs was the traitor, and her father had died to save Karr's life. Once convinced of his innocence, Vevec was able to come to terms with Karr, and the two departed Napdu together to seek the truth behind Auch's betrayal and exact justice on the treacherous ''Mand'alor''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've tracked that man for almost ten years, and if I've lost him now because of you metal ''dikuts''&hellip;"<br />"Tes! We need to talk!''"<br />"''You need to ''die''!|Vevec and Hondo Karr, amidst fighting security droids|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
[[File:Tes_Vevec_Amor.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Tes Vevec in her [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]]]
Tes Vevec was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and the ex-wife of [[Hondo Karr]]. Her father, the Mandalorian warrior [[Vevec]], was killed at the [[Battle of Botajef]]. Following the death of her father, Tes dedicated her life to hunting down her ex-husband, whom she wrongly believed to be responsible. She was deceived by the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Yaga Auchs]], who claimed that Hondo was a traitor to the Mandalorian people.<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

In [[137 ABY]], she tracked down Hondo on [[Napdu]], where he was on a mission for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. The two engaged in a brawl, but eventually Karr was able to disarm her and reveal her the true story of the events surrounding Botajef. Reunited, Tes and Hondo came to an agreement to work together and find proof of Yaga Auchs's treachery.<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Why do you always have to make it so hard, ''cyar'ika''?|[[Hondo Karr]], Vevec's ex-husband|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
==Equipment==
Vevec wore Mandalorian armor [[Color/Legends|colored]] primarily orange<ref name="RoguesEnd" />—the color Mandalorians traditionally associated with a lust for life, or ''shereshoy'', in their culture<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>—with silver shoulder plates, yellow armor plates on her biceps, and a purple painted trim around her helmet's multi-tiered, red-tinted visor. She wore a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] with several pouches around her waist, from which hung a maroon-colored [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] and the [[Holster/Legends|holster]] for her blaster pistol. Both of Vevec's gauntlets were equipped with retractable vibroblades. Vevec was also in possession of a starship.<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tes Vevec first appeared in the forty-first issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, [[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]], where she was introduced as the vengeful ex-wife of Hondo Karr. Though the two were able to reconcile by issue's end, the story of their search for the truth behind Yaga Auchs was left unresolved in both ''Star Wars: Legacy'', and it's mini-series sequel, [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']].
